headline: Chief of Police appointment, a $558,500 water fund use, and a recycling collection ordinance.
summary: Anthony Geraci is up for confirmation as Chief of Police. The agenda also includes a recycling collection ordinance, a $558,500 water fund use, several business permits, and a set of grants.
items: Confirm Anthony Geraci as Chief of Police
Recycling collection requirements ordinance, first reading, referred to Ordinance Committee
Use up to $558,500 from the Water fund for drinking water planning projects
$230,450.02 state grant for Balanced and Restorative Justice
$741,500 insurance renewal for Burlington Electric property and boiler coverage
Indoor entertainment permit changes for Thingz From Yaad, 152 Cherry Street
Indoor entertainment permit for Vermont Comedy Arts, 118 Main Street
Tobacco substitute endorsement for Henry Street Deli Mart, 11 Henry Street
Tobacco license and endorsement for Wolfs Convenience Store LLC, 457 St. Paul Street
Police Commission resignation of Julia Ginorio, with the vacancy to be advertised
Several public letters on planBTV New North End traffic changes for Tracy and Loaldo drives, placed on file
Winooski Valley Park District annual report and funding request, placed on file
Consent agenda also includes minutes from three October 26 meetings and other items placed on file
